column1: # regenerated: 2026-09-02 (#3550/#3556 — RT-4/RT-10 metric-contract fixes)
# regenerated: 2026-08-27 (#3005 — partial: draw-split + entities only)
# corrected:   2026-08-28 (#3407 — the draw-split rows below were wrong)
# READ THIS FIRST — the two draw-split rows were transcription errors.
# The 2026-08-27 refresh wrote `bench_draws_batches 164` and
# `bench_draws_gpu_calls 9`. Neither value reproduces. Six runs across three
# builds — including a rebuild of the exact commit the refresh says it
# measured at, run with the exact invocation it documents — all read
# 1581/100b/11c, with entities_total (3493), meshes (609) and cmds (1581)
# identical in every one. Both wrong values have a traceable provenance in
# adjacent text: 164 is FNV's 2026-08-12 spike batch count, printed two lines
# from this cell in the bisect timeline the FNV baseline header carries
# (`9e96a9f9 2026-08-12 2562/164b/35c`); 9 is this cell's OWN pre-existing
# 2026-06-14 gpu_calls, i.e. the row that was supposedly refreshed is the row
# that was never updated. See #3407 and docs/audits/AUDIT_RUNTIME_2026-08-27.md.
# WHY THIS MOVED, before the numbers (the #3005 CAUSE-NOT-BASELINE box).
# The 2026-08-16 sweep flagged this cell past the x1.1 contract on BOTH
# bench_draws_batches and bench_draws_gpu_calls while bench_draws_cmds stayed
# inside it. Re-measured at cc666a48 on 2026-08-27
# (`--game fo3 --cell MegatonPlayerHouse --bench-frames 240`, xvfb), with the
# true values #3407 established:
#   metric               2026-06-14 baseline   2026-08-27   x1.1 gate
#   bench_draws_cmds     1839                  1581         PASS (fell)
#   bench_draws_batches    96                   100         PASS (x1.04)
#   bench_draws_gpu_calls   9                    11         FAIL (x1.22)
# That is the MIRROR IMAGE of what the 2026-08-27 header claimed. The batch
# split never left contract on this cell — 96 -> 100 is inside x1.1 and did
# not need refreshing at all. It is the gpu_calls half that is still out, so
# #3005's `fo3` arm was closed on a measurement that does not hold (its `fnv`
# arm does: 26 -> 26, exact). Kept refreshed rather than reverted to 96/9
# because 9 against a true 11 is permanently red and would drown any real
# regression; the residual gpu_calls question belongs to #3005, not to this
# file.
# The cause is not a batching bug and is already documented in code: see
# `draw_sort_key`'s alpha-over branch in `byroredux/src/render/mod.rs`
# (RT-1 / #2215). True alpha-over draws sort depth-primary, so draws that
# would otherwise share `group_state` stop being contiguous whenever a
# different-state alpha-over draw sits at an intervening depth — each
# interruption opens a new `DrawBatch`. That ordering is the deliberate,
# required cost of the #1804/#2237 compositing fix (a farther decal/puddle
# drawing after a nearer glass pane and showing through as a rectangular
# patch); a state-primary sort can only be correct when the interleaved draws
# never overlap on screen, which this key cannot determine. That comment
# records the direct experiment: forcing state-primary order drops FNV
# `FreesideAtomicWrangler` from 25 to 8 GPU calls.
# Merge efficiency here fell 19.2 -> 15.8 cmds/batch (1839/96 -> 1581/100),
# not 19.2 -> 9.6: that figure was computed from the wrong batch count. The
# draw_sort_key explanation above still applies — it accounts for a 15.8
# cmds/batch split as readily as it would for 9.6 — but the magnitude it is
# accounting for is a 4% move, not a 71% one.
# entities_total 3311 -> 3493 (+5.5%) also exceeds its +/-2% tolerance and is
# refreshed with the same measurement.
# PARTIAL REFRESH — only the rows this run measured were updated:
# entities_total, bench_fps_*, bench_draws_*, skin_pool_*. The
# `byro-dbg`-sourced rows (tex_missing_unique_paths, mesh_cache_failed_count,
# light_count_directional) were NOT re-captured in this session and are
# carried forward from 2026-06-14 unchanged — do not read them as re-verified.
# #3550/RT-4 — `tex_missing_unique_paths` split into `tex_missing_base_color`
# (strict gate) + `tex_missing_all_slots` (informational); see
# `.claude/commands/audit-runtime/SKILL.md` §Phase 3. base_color stays 0
# (EXACT PASS per the RT-4 evidence table, re-confirmed live 2026-08-30 —
# this row is no longer stale despite the PARTIAL REFRESH note above);
# all_slots is a new, non-gating row at 12 (the full 26-role surface, #3349).
# #3556/RT-10 — light_count_directional was derived from block presence
# (always 1, could never fail — #3424); the real per-emitter dump measures
# 0 directional / 11 point. Added light_count_point, corrected
# light_count_directional. Both are freshly captured, unlike the PARTIAL
